data.name: Description
data.value: Follow preparation and inspect resources while Bootstrap runs. Execution becomes available once preparation completes.

data.name: AccessUnavailableDescription
data.value: Sign out and try again later.

data.name: ConnectionLostDescription
data.value: The instance cannot be reached. Observation will resume when the connection is restored.

data.name: Recovery
data.value: Bootstrap stopped. Review the failed resource and apply an available model correction here to resume. For other failures, correct the configuration and restart the instance.

data.name: Explanation_topology
data.value: Preparing storage, identity, tenants, workspaces and enrollment policies.

data.name: Explanation_extensions
data.value: Waiting for the extensions and contributions required by the selected profiles.

data.name: Explanation_resources
data.value: Applying the selected resources and checking their required dependencies.

data.name: Explanation_finalization
data.value: Finishing preparation before making the Console available.

data.name: ModelMissing
data.value: Waiting for the exact required model.

data.name: ProviderUnavailable
data.value: The provider is not available yet. Discovery will retry within the Bootstrap deadline.

data.name: ContributionMissing
data.value: Waiting for a required extension contribution.

data.name: GateConnectionLostDescription
data.value: The instance is temporarily unavailable. Try again.

data.name: DependencyFailureDescription
data.value: A required dependency could not be resolved.

data.name: SearchResources
data.value: Search by resource, profile or scope

data.name: ResourceReadFailed
data.value: Resource details are temporarily unavailable. Observation will resume automatically.

data.name: NotStarted
data.value: This resource has not been applied yet.

data.name: ConsultationAvailable
data.value: You can inspect resources. Some actions remain unavailable until preparation finishes.

data.name: CorrectionAccepted
data.value: The selection was saved. Bootstrap will resume with this provider and model.

data.name: CorrectionHelp
data.value: This change applies to this profile in the current Bootstrap plan and is retained on this instance after restart. Source files are not modified.

data.name: NoCachedModels
data.value: No available model is currently known for this provider. Refresh this list after discovery.

data.name: CorrectionStale
data.value: The resource or selection changed. Close and reopen the form before applying your correction.

data.name: CorrectionUnavailable
data.value: The correction cannot be loaded or applied right now. Try again.

data.name: CorrectionInvalid
data.value: This model is unavailable or incompatible with the profile settings. Refresh the choices and select another model.

data.name: SubstitutionApplied
data.value: A provider/model substitution was saved for this plan.

data.name: FailureLegacy
data.value: The precise cause was not recorded for this application. Review the failed resource and its dependencies, then use the application identity to inspect server logs.

data.name: Failure_validation
data.value: Resource validation or publication failed. Check the resource definition and its required Flow, Tool and profile bindings. Resources already created are retained.

data.name: Failure_configuration
data.value: The resource configuration could not be applied. Check its required fields, scope and dependencies; use the log reference for the server diagnostic.

data.name: Failure_access
data.value: Access or resource governance prevented this operation. Check the target scope and the permissions on its dependencies.

data.name: Failure_dependency
data.value: A required resource is unavailable. Check that dependencies are created earlier and are accessible from the target scope.

data.name: Failure_timeout
data.value: The required dependency did not become available before the deadline. Check the provider, extension or required model, then retry after correcting the dependency.

data.name: Failure_storage
data.value: Storage could not complete the operation. Check storage availability and access rights using the log reference.

data.name: Failure_provider
data.value: The provider could not be reached. Check its availability and connection configuration.

data.name: Failure_unexpected
data.value: An unexpected error stopped this resource. Completed resources are retained. Use the reason code and log reference to investigate before preparing a new application.

data.name: FailureFlowUnavailable
data.value: The acquisition or discovery Flow is missing, disabled or incompatible in the target scope. Check its revision and access permissions.

data.name: FailureToolUnavailable
data.value: A required Tool or its provider is missing or unavailable. Check the profile bindings and the Tool and provider configuration in the target scope.

data.name: FailureProfileUnpublished
data.value: The referenced profile has no active published revision. Review and publish the profile before retrying the resource.

data.name: CompletedDescription
data.value: Preparation is complete. Review the results, then open the Console when you are ready.
